title: Grateful Dead Live at Kiel Auditorium on 1982-08-04

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard capture of a scorching first set highlighted by a smoking "CC Rider" and tight "Brown Eyed Women", with solid but uneven second‑set moments.
ai_review.review: The recording is a clean, well‑balanced SBD that lets the band’s interplay shine, especially on the blistering first‑set sequence of "Looks Like Rain → Foolish Heart → CC Rider" and the fiery "Brown Eyed Women".  While the second set opens unusually with a gritty "Never Trust A Woman" and includes a solid "Row Jimmy", some listeners note a slower, blues‑y vibe and occasional vocal slips from Garcia and Bob.  Overall the show is energetic and enjoyable, though the mix can feel uneven at times.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise both performance and sound quality (average ~4‑5 stars), with a few noting vocal or mix issues; weighted average of show (≈4) and recording (≈4) yields a solid 4‑star rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clean sound with clear piano/organ and guitar tones; several reviewers note an uneven mix and lack of bass depth in places, but overall the SBD is listenable and captures band interplay.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set is tight and high‑energy, building to a powerful "CC Rider"; second set opens with an unexpected "Never Trust A Woman" after the space segment, maintaining momentum but feeling a bit slower overall.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Leads on "CC Rider", "Brown Eyed Women" and "Row Jimmy" are described as vintage, powerful blues; tone praised throughout.
band_member_comments.Bob: Vocals described as ferocious early in the show but later noted as off or insufferable on "Stranger", "Round and Round" and "Looks Like Rain".
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent’s piano/organ work highlighted as strong, with a distinct pop intro and heavy B3 presence; overall keyboard sound praised.
